---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

OpenThread is using the mbedTLS implementation of ChaChaPoly.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hex Dump is enabled for MLE ENCRYPTION.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The build is for a Thread Device running only 802.15.4: FTD, MTD, SED, or SSED.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Building for the Throughput and Packet Loss experiments.
